XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Airbag warning light on, odometer flashing, seat belt warning light and buzzer not working
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | CONTROL UNIT | AIRBAG | B10AA | U0019 | U0422 | U1703 | U1726 | LIGHTS UP | LIGHTED | LIGHTED | YELLOW | YELLOW | FASTENED | UNFASTENED | COMMUNICATION | WARNING | ACOUSTIC | ODO METER | KILOMETRES | BELT| SAFETY | BUZZER |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Airbag control unit

  • Fault: Airbag warning light illuminated, odometer flashing, seatbelt warning light and buzzer not functioning

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B10AA (Proxy alignment check)
    • U0019 (CAN data bus – communication error)
    • U0422 (Active suspension control unit, Data received – invalid)
    • U1703 (CAN data bus, Instrument cluster control unit – Error)
    • U1726 (No communication between instrument cluster and airbag control unit)
  • Cause: Faulty airbag control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the airbag control unit and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, following the replacement of the airbag control unit, proxy alignment was necessary because the odometer started flashing, indicating a misalignment of the CAN network.
